Definition: from G846 and a derivative or G2632; self-condemned:--condemned of self.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says the heretic, after the first and second admonition, is to be rejected, because he is subverted and sins, being condemned of himself. The word means self-condemned, judged by his own words.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a person who will not be corrected has already passed sentence on himself, and the church's rejection only names what he has done.
